Intersections have cardinality p^d with d=rank(I−φ)−rank((I−φ)^2); independence of Fourier coordinates counts every pair of ranks and both marginals. Supports include h=0 and h=m. The 8 direct-basis finite enumerations perform 66,096 modular matrix rank computations with exact agreement; finite checking only corroborates proof.
